title: Create: Physics And Aeronautics
description: A Create modpack centered around physics, roads, and vehicles, featuring planes, cars, trucks, and more.
body:
![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/28e53968d0576cd3846df9b68304009fe658a147.png)

Also check out Create: Aeronautics, the core mod this pack is built around.

--- ## Trailer Sneak Peek

This is only a sneak peek of the trailer, not the full trailer.

--- ## About Create: Phys & Aeronautics is a modpack built around the mod **Create: Aeronautics**, combining Create-style engineering with a performance-focused setup. You can build things like planes, cars, machines, entire factories, and lots of other cool stuff. It originally started as a lightweight “Lite” pack for lower-end PCs, but evolved into a more complete gameplay experience instead of just a trimmed-down version. > **Note:** This modpack is made for **NeoForge 1.21.1** and will not work on other Minecraft versions or mod loaders such as Fabric. --- ## Contact If you need help, want to give feedback, or just hang out: * **Discord (preferred):** Join the server using the button above * **Direct contact:** `arthurbao12` --- ## How to install (Modrinth) 1. Download the modpack from this page. 2. Create a new instance in your launcher. 3. Import the modpack. 4. Launch and play. --- ## Troubleshooting If this prompt appears during loading: ![Error](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9e81b07199e5b43cdb69f7187c22bc9e6c49ac4.png) Click **Yes**, then restart the game. **If the game crashes on startup:** * Remove the mod `Simple Custom Early Loading Screen` * Delete the `fml.toml` file inside the `config` folder **If the game crashes on startup with a different error:** * Try using Java 21 if you aren't already. Other Java versions (newer or older) may cause issues with this modpack. ---

## Authors * **arthursimao567** — Creator and maintainer of Create: Phys & Aeronautics * **jacobxny** — Helped with feedback, testing, and improving the modpack description ## Music * **Potato** — *"Wanderlust"* Used as the previous main menu theme. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BcwpQgv_k-k * **Starlotte** — *"Cirrus"* Used as the current main menu theme. https://starlotte.bandcamp.com/track/cirrus Licensed under **CC BY-SA 4.0**: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ No modifications were made to the original track. ## Mods, Assets & Other Contributions * **Create: Aeronautics** The core mod this pack is built around. The Andesite Propeller model used in the modpack logo comes from Create: Aeronautics. https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics * **Create: Aeronautics Team** Thanks for the original models, assets, and branding work that helped shape the identity of this modpack. * **Reimagined Intro** by **NoobTrieu** Used with permission from the original creator. https://modrinth.com/user/NoobTrieu Includes the custom intro animation featured in this modpack. * **Stoat** by **Bobisnotaperson** https://modrinth.com/datapack/stoat * **Create: Addon Organizer** by **SockyWocky** https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-addon-organizer A very useful tool for organizing Create addons and mod sections, especially in a large modpack with many included mods. ## Special Thanks * All mod developers whose work is included in this modpack. * Everyone who tested the pack, reported bugs, and provided feedback. * The Create community for the inspiration and creativity that made projects like this possible.
